- Create keypair: `node -e "..."` writes makefun-keypair.json in solana-keygen format (64 bytes array)

- SIWS: /api/auth/siws/nonce → sign message → POST /api/auth/solana/key → returns af_ key + handle. Add "ga" referral to body.
- Key stored in ~/.makefun/credentials

Note: registration also needs `user` — the key response has user.handle.
